source.title: Lipedema Foundation Common Case Report Form (CCRF)
source.countDefinition: Official website counts of substantive common data elements (CDEs), reported separately from technical REDCap data-dictionary rows.
source.notice: Official CDE totals are taken from the Lipedema Foundation CCRF webpage. REDCap dictionary-row counts are reported separately because the workbooks also contain technical, administrative, instructional and calculated rows. Calculated fields are preserved as supplied; no calculation is inferred when the official expression is blank.
source.calculationPolicy: Execute only an exact official CCRF calculation expression after its REDCap behaviour is validated. The current official dictionaries mark calculated fields but provide blank calculation expressions, so LipoScope does not calculate those values.

fields.label:
Stemmer Sign

Performing the Stemmer Sign test: Perform test while participant is seated with feet on the ground. Examiner pinches the dorsal skin proximal to the MTP joint of the second toe (or MCP joint of the second finger).

If the examiner cannot create a fold of pinched skin, this results in a positive sign. If you cannot pinch, the Stemmer sign is positive, and Lymphedema is likely present.

If you can pinch, the Stemmer sign is negative, and Lymphedema is likely not present.
fields.choices: 1, Positive Stemmer Sign | 0, Negative Stemmer Sign

fields.label:
Stemmer Sign

Performing the Stemmer Sign test: Perform test while participant is seated with feet on the ground. Examiner pinches the dorsal skin proximal to the MTP joint of the second toe (or MCP joint of the second finger).

If the examiner cannot create a fold of pinched skin, this results in a positive sign. If you cannot pinch, the Stemmer sign is positive, and Lymphedema is likely present.

If you can pinch, the Stemmer sign is negative, and Lymphedema is likely not present.

fields.label:
Stemmer Sign

Performing the Stemmer Sign test: Perform test while participant is seated with feet on the ground. Examiner pinches the dorsal skin proximal to the MTP joint of the second toe (or MCP joint of the second finger).

If the examiner cannot create a fold of pinched skin, this results in a positive sign. If you cannot pinch, the Stemmer sign is positive, and Lymphedema is likely present.

If you can pinch, the Stemmer sign is negative, and Lymphedema is likely not present.

fields.label:
Stemmer Sign

Performing the Stemmer Sign test: Perform test while participant is seated with feet on the ground. Examiner pinches the dorsal skin proximal to the MTP joint of the second toe (or MCP joint of the second finger).

If the examiner cannot create a fold of pinched skin, this results in a positive sign. If you cannot pinch, the Stemmer sign is positive, and Lymphedema is likely present.

If you can pinch, the Stemmer sign is negative, and Lymphedema is likely not present.
fields.choices: 1, Positive Stemmer Sign | 0, Negative Stemmer Sign
